capability.summary: Convert one local JSON object to TOML text in a JSON envelope
capability.description: Reads one UTF-8 JSON file, requires its root to be an object, serializes it with tomli-w, and returns the TOML text in the `toml` field without writing a file.
capability.problem_space: In-memory JSON-object-to-TOML text conversion for a single local file; not TOML file creation, arbitrary JSON-root conversion, TOML parsing, or round-trip preservation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing UTF-8 JSON file whose root is an object. Output: a JSON envelope containing TOML text or a structured handled error; the source is not modified and no TOML file is created.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 JSON file with an object at the document root
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "tomli-w", target: string, toml: string}, exit 0. Missing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Non-object root: {status: "error", message: "TOML root must be a JSON object"}, exit 1. JSON syntax failure: {status: "error", tool: "tomli-w", message: string}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON; unsupported values or read/serialization failures may traceback.
limitations: returns TOML only as a string inside JSON and never creates or modifies a TOML file
requires a JSON object root; JSON null, arrays, and scalar roots are rejected, while TOML-incompatible nested values may raise an uncaught serialization error
uses UTF-8 input, has no timeout or output truncation, and does not preserve JSON formatting or comments

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing generated TOML text or a handled conversion error; no output file is written.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: convert a JSON object file to TOML text
serialize local JSON configuration as TOML
negative_intents: write or modify a TOML file
convert JSON arrays or scalar roots to TOML
parse TOML or convert TOML to JSON
